g.text: BC-06 Fulfillment & Delivery — Logical Database Design
delivery_id is an identity reference between independent roots.
No Delivery ownership relation is stored for POD or TemperatureEvidence.
PK = primary key | FK = local foreign key | required = NOT NULL.
Buyer relationship and human identity are typed IDs; no buyer membership exists.
Evidence bytes are external to this logical relational design.
